Metadata.title: Beeanie English Institute | Learn English with Confidence
Metadata.description: BeeaniEnglish Institute helps students speak English with confidence through practical classes, mentoring, and a warm community.

Hero.title: Learn English in a fun way and speak with confidence.
Hero.lead: We help students improve their communication skills through guided speaking practice and dynamic online lessons. Whether you are starting from zero or leveling up, Beeanie is your safe place for English!

small.title: Small groups
small.body: More speaking time and personal feedback

community.title: Supportive community
community.body: You're not alone on this journey! Join our exclusive channel and interact with students and supportive teachers!

general.title: General English
general.body: Build your foundation in speaking, listening, writing, and grammar with practical everyday topics.

conversation.title: Conversation Club
conversation.body: Improve your fluency and build your confidence through guided conversation sessions, roleplays and hot topics that will put your skills to the test.

exam.title: Exam Preparation
exam.body: Prepare for interviews or proficiency exams with strategic practice, corrections, and personalized study plans.

Method.title: A simple method that creates real progress

placement.title: Placement & goals
placement.body: We start with your current level and define goals that fit your routine and motivation.

practice.title: Guided practice
practice.body: Every class combines clear explanations with immediate speaking and listening practice as well as interactive games to make sure you fully understand each lesson.

feedback.title: Feedback & growth
feedback.body: You receive tailored feedback and corrections after each class. We detect your pain points and work on them.

reasons.friendly: Friendly classes with structure and clear objectives
reasons.speaking: High speaking time in every lesson
reasons.motivation: Consistent motivation through a positive learning culture

Testimonials.title: Results that feel real in everyday life

adult.body: I used to be afraid of speaking in class. Now I can communicate confidently at work meetings.

parent.body: The classes are dynamic and clear. My teenager now enjoys English and participates more in school.

club.body: I loved the positive vibe. I improved pronunciation and learned vocabulary I actually use daily.

Contact.title: Book your trial class with {brand}
Contact.lead: Send us a message and we will help you choose the right program for your current level and goals.
Contact.cardLead: We usually reply within one business day.
